title: package-mac
responsibility: Owns the package-mac build or maintenance script.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown at module load when process.platform is not 'darwin', with the message 'This package target requires macOS.'; no command or file operation in this file runs before it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Packaging requires a public canonical HTTPS HARNESS_RELEASE_HUB_ORIGIN before signing or staging. The origin is compiled into the staged Electron main bundle.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Packaging requires HARNESS_MAC_SIGN_IDENTITY to be an exact 40-character Developer ID Application certificate fingerprint. Verification does not use a signing identity.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Packaging is refused before staging when the selected build keychain is missing or does not contain a Developer ID Application identity matching the selected fingerprint and team PAC8VHDW3G.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Verification requires hardened runtime and the exact stable Developer ID designated requirement for dev.harness.desktop and team PAC8VHDW3G on the app and the Safe Storage migration helper. The bundle including nested code must also pass strict verification and declare the Harness product name. An unsupported command line is refused.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Bundling, system command and filesystem errors propagate. A staging, bundling, signing or verification failure leaves the existing dist/mac/Harness.app in place.
